transcript.text: I need to flag a critical issue. During this week's load test, I measured the Orpheum's loading-dock lift and it has a hard 900-kilogram limit. Our drafted rotating scenic unit weighs 1,100 kilograms, which exceeds that by 200 kilos. The good news is that splitting it into two 550-kilogram modules is workable. I haven't updated the load-in drawing yet, but I can do that once we agree on the approach.

transcript.text: I need to flag a critical insurance requirement. I obtained the insurer's written event endorsement this morning, and it requires that the audience be seated in three blocks separated by two unobstructed aisles, each at least 1.2 meters wide, for our coverage to remain valid. The current draft plan seats the audience in two blocks, which does not meet this requirement. I should also note that the endorsement is currently still attached to my email rather than the production file, so I'll make sure it gets properly filed once we agree on how to proceed.
